about: Narration placement for Phase 01. 'src' = seconds in public/audio/narration.m4a (the narrator's recording, loudness-normalised). 'at' = film second where the segment's src start lands. Word times come from src/data/narration_transcript.json (speech recognition, verified against the approved script). Edit (quality upgrade): cold open on the first line over a close-up, the reveal of the crossroads on 'here', then the title read over the wide.

segments.note: Have you ever looked at your life… and wondered how you ended up here?
When Life Doesn't Go as Planned · Deeply Rooted · Episode One
Not because everything is terrible. But because…
this isn't where you thought you would be.
You had dreams. You imagined a different version of yourself by now.
